scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend
scripts.docker:prod:config: npm run routing:validate && docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.routing.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml config --quiet
scripts.docker:prod:start: npm run routing:validate && docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.routing.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 2400
scripts.docker:prod:stop: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.routing.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
scripts.docker:prod:status: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.routing.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml ps
scripts.docker:prod:logs: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.routing.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f --tail 100
scripts.routing:start: npm run routing:validate && docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.routing.yml up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 2400
